section.63: Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)

63.name_native: Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)

hadiths.text: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the funeral prayer for the Negus and made us stand in rows behind him and I was in the second or third row
